tokens.label: Ticks per second at 1x
tokens.doc: How many ticks 1x plays per second. The site plays 500 ms per tick (2 ticks per second); the speed buttons multiply this.

tokens.label: Simulation step rate
tokens.doc: The clock advances in exact steps of 1/rate seconds; the renderer interpolates between steps. Independent of the display refresh rate.

tokens.label: Longest frame the clock accepts
tokens.doc: A frame longer than this (a stalled or hidden tab) advances the clock by this much only, so the battle cannot fast-forward after a stall.

tokens.label: Speed ease time
tokens.doc: Play, pause and speed changes ease in and out over about this time (0 = instant).

tokens.label: Seek glide time
tokens.doc: A seek or a jump to a scene flies the clock to the target with a critically damped glide of this time constant instead of teleporting.

tokens.label: Seek glide speed cap
tokens.doc: The glide never flies faster than this, so a long jump is a fly-through of the interpolated paths, not a blur.

tokens.label: At the end of the battle
tokens.doc: What happens when playback reaches the last tick.

tokens.label: Motion model
tokens.doc: How a unit moves between its own keyframes. All models are exact at every keyframe; between keyframes the position is Modelled.

tokens.label: Start and stop
tokens.doc: Whether a unit's track starts and ends at rest (eased) or with the velocity of its first and last segment.

tokens.label: Strength bar tween
tokens.doc: When a unit's current keyframe changes its strength, the bar eases to the new value over this time. The value itself is the keyframe's, never interpolated into numbers that are not in the data.

tokens.label: Layout strategy
tokens.doc: Which layout module places the tiles. certified guarantees zero overlap; raw is a diagnostic that shows the unsolved problem.

tokens.label: Which units are on the map

options.label: Carry forward (what the site draws today)

tokens.doc: The visibility rule decides how many tiles exist at all (typical 384 under carry-forward, 44 under a window, 7 under the snapshot; 03-data-fuel.md section 9.1).

tokens.label: Fresh window
tokens.doc: Under the window rule a unit is shown only within this many ticks before or after one of its own keyframes.

tokens.label: Displacement budget
tokens.doc: How far a tile may sit from its true position so it can be read (a pin and a leader line stay on the true position). 0 = pure aggregation. Beyond the budget the tile is merged into an aggregate.

tokens.label: Clearance between tiles
tokens.doc: Minimum free space between any two tile boxes.

tokens.label: Split hysteresis band
tokens.doc: An aggregate tries to split only when its members would fit within the budget minus this band, so it does not flicker.

tokens.label: Return speed
tokens.doc: How fast a displaced tile drifts back toward its true position when there is room.

tokens.label: Aggregate dwell
tokens.doc: An aggregate exists at least this long before a split is tried (merge now, split later).

tokens.label: Label show delay
tokens.doc: A name label may appear only after it has fitted for this long (it disappears at once when it stops fitting).

tokens.label: Label cool-down
tokens.doc: After a name label is hidden (something took its place) it may not come back for this long, so a label does not blink while tiles jostle.

tokens.label: Labels from zoom
tokens.doc: Below this zoom no name labels are drawn.

tokens.label: Neighbourhood cap
tokens.doc: A neighbourhood with more obstacles than this is declared saturated and the tile aggregates (a conservative failure: never an overlap).

tokens.label: Protect true positions
tokens.doc: No tile may cover another tile's true position.

tokens.label: Name labels
tokens.doc: Show the secondary name labels where they fit.

tokens.label: Continuity radius
tokens.doc: EXPERIMENT. A tile that already has a place never jumps farther than this from it in one frame: when the only free place is farther it merges into an aggregate instead. Measured to multiply aggregate churn by ten at 14 px (see README), so it is off; the display layer travels instead. 0 = off.

tokens.label: Split trials per frame
tokens.doc: At most this many aggregates try to split in one frame.

tokens.label: Display dynamics
tokens.doc: dynamics = smooth glide with collision-aware pushing; spring = smooth glide only; snap = show the layout as solved (the lab behaviour, for comparison).

tokens.label: Glide time
tokens.doc: Time constant of the glide that carries a tile to its newly solved position.

tokens.label: Glide speed cap
tokens.doc: A displaced tile never glides faster than this.

tokens.label: Travel distance
tokens.doc: A tile whose solved place is farther than this from where it stands does not push its way there: it dims below 0.5 opacity, glides through, and solidifies on arrival, so it neither obscures nor is obscured on the way.

tokens.label: Travel glide time
tokens.doc: Glide time constant of a dimmed travelling tile.

tokens.label: Travel opacity
tokens.doc: Opacity of a travelling tile; must stay below 0.5, the opacity rule's threshold between solid and not solid.

tokens.label: Largest push
tokens.doc: A contact moves a tile by at most this much per pass, so tiles are eased apart instead of shoved. What still overlaps is repaired by the safety net.

tokens.label: Collision passes
tokens.doc: Passes of the pushing solver per frame.

tokens.label: Fade time
tokens.doc: Duration of a tile's fade in or out. Two tiles that hand over to each other never both have opacity of 0.5 or more at once.

tokens.label: Birth size
tokens.doc: A new tile grows from this fraction of its size, pushing its neighbours gently aside.

tokens.label: Label fade time
tokens.doc: Fade of a name label.

tokens.label: Cross-fade time of a cut
tokens.doc: When the picture changes too much for a glide (a jump in time or zoom) the old tiles fade out and the new ones fade in, in sequence.

tokens.label: Zoom jump that cuts
tokens.doc: A zoom change larger than this in one frame is a cut (cross-fade) instead of a glide.

tokens.label: Time jump that cuts
tokens.doc: A tick change larger than this in one frame is a cut (cross-fade) instead of a glide.

tokens.label: Safety net
tokens.doc: Every displayed frame is verified; of two solid tiles that would still overlap the lighter one is dimmed below 0.5 and travels to its certified place (counted). Turn off only to measure how often it fires.

tokens.label: Reduced motion
tokens.doc: Reduced motion lands seeks at once and shows the layout as solved, with short fades.

tokens.label: Zoom
tokens.doc: Map zoom (Mapbox 512 px world). The site opens at 13.5; desktop views are clamped to 12.04 or more.

tokens.label: Zoom glide
tokens.doc: Wheel zoom glides with this time constant.

tokens.label: Pan glide
tokens.doc: Camera moves (scene jumps) glide with this time constant.

tokens.label: Lowest zoom
tokens.doc: Lowest zoom the Studio allows.

tokens.label: Highest zoom
tokens.doc: Highest zoom the Studio allows (the site's maximum is 18).

tokens.label: Leader lines
tokens.doc: Draw a thin line from a displaced tile to its pin on the true position.

tokens.label: True-position pins
tokens.doc: Draw a pin on the true position of every displaced tile.

tokens.label: Aggregate member dots
tokens.doc: Draw a dot on the true position of every record an aggregate stands for.

tokens.label: Click tolerance
tokens.doc: Extra pixels around a tile that still count as a click on it.

tokens.label: Skin
tokens.doc: The skin that draws the tiles. The Studio ships one built-in REFERENCE skin that exercises every channel; design pitches register their own.

tokens.label: Last-fix age channel
tokens.doc: Reference skin: dim and dash the outline of a tile whose latest keyframe is old, so a carried-forward tile does not look like a fresh report (03-data-fuel.md).

tokens.label: Backdrop
tokens.doc: Schematic ground. Mapbox tiles are token-restricted, so the Studio draws a plain metric grid; it is not terrain.

tokens.label: Grid spacing
tokens.doc: Spacing of the metric grid.

tokens.label: Place marks
tokens.doc: Show the 30 named places of terrain.json in the legacy frame the placements were authored in. 8 of them differ from production terrain.json by 166 to 733 m (Computed in the dataset); marks are orientation only.

tokens.label: Metrics overlay
tokens.doc: Show frame times, motion, overlap and solve cost live.

tokens.label: History length
tokens.doc: Frames kept for the graphs and the export.

tokens.label: Pop threshold
tokens.doc: A tile that moves more than this beyond its true position's own motion in one frame counts as a pop (the lab definition).

tokens.label: Verify every frame
tokens.doc: Run the independent overlap verifier on every displayed frame (about 0.2 ms).
